reviewContext.userProblem: PdfFilePreviewPane renders PDFs in an <iframe> with the WebKit built-in viewer, which captures keyboard focus so the app keymap (KeymapProvider, WorkspaceShell, workspaceShortcuts) and the +/- zoom handler never run while a PDF is open. Previews also lack Alt (Option)+wheel zoom.
requiredOutcomes: With a PDF open, Shift+L, Cmd+O/Ctrl+O, +/-, r, Shift+D, j/k (document scroll, or file-list selection when it has focus), Enter and q behave exactly as for other previews, covered by vitest tests.

Alt+wheel and Ctrl+wheel (including trackpad pinch) zoom Markdown/rendered, image, video and PDF previews using the same pane-local zoom state as +/-; wheel up zooms in; default scroll is prevented only when zooming.
PDF still reloads on explicit refresh and on revision or localResourceGeneration change.
README shortcut documentation mentions Alt+wheel zoom.
bun run typecheck, bun run test, bun run test:dom, bun run lint:biome and CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true cargo check pass; debug build launches and renders a PDF.
nonGoals: PDF text layer, text selection, links, outline, forms, annotation editing, search and printing (canvas-only rendering).
Persisted zoom or zoom shared across panes/windows.
Any change to keymap bindings or keymap.toml semantics.
constraints: Keep existing shortcut behavior for non-PDF previews unchanged.
Follow AGENTS.md: Bun scripts for verification, CARGO_TERM_QUIET=true for cargo, no emojis, commit messages without AI attribution.
pdfjs-dist is pinned to an exact version with no trustedDependencies; the worker and resources are bundled/served via Vite from the app origin.
Rust/src-tauri changes are limited to the connect-src CSP directive in src-tauri/tauri.conf.json; worker-src only via a runtime-evidenced blocker.
Each plan edits only its writePaths; no git operations by implementers; workspace-wide gates run only in serial wave-3 pdf-shortcuts-finalize.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Replace the PDF iframe with pdf.js (legacy build) canvases rendered inside the normal .pane__body scroll container, with no iframe and no focusable elements.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Keeps key events in the main document so the existing keymap and activeDocumentNavigation j/k scrolling work without new wiring.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Worker loaded via Vite ?worker import and a workerPort singleton that resets on failure; cMapUrl, standardFontDataUrl and wasmUrl point at app-origin resources copied by a pdfjsResources Vite plugin; useWasm:false, isEvalSupported:false, enableXfa:false.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Avoids fake-worker fallback and remote resources, and minimizes the attack surface for untrusted PDF parsing in the app origin.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: A single exported pure predicate previewZoomDirectionFromWheel (Alt or Ctrl + nonzero deltaY) plus exported zoom bounds in PreviewPane.tsx, reused by the PDF and video panes.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: One shared zoom input contract instead of copied literals; callers decide preventDefault.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: PDF re-renders at zoom*devicePixelRatio with a 50-300% clamp; reload is guarded by a load generation and render-task cancellation.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Sharp output at any zoom and race-free rapid zoom/reload.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Video gains pane-local 50-300% zoom; audio has none.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Accepted QA default in design-docs/user-qa/qa-pdf-inline-rendering.md; images are already zoomed by PreviewPane.

designDecisionsAndRationale.decision: Three waves: (1) pdf-zoom-wheel-contract || pdf-pdfjs-foundation, (2) pdf-canvas-pane || pdf-video-zoom, (3) pdf-shortcuts-finalize serial.
designDecisionsAndRationale.rationale: Disjoint writePaths within each wave; workspace-wide gates and the packaged runtime check run once serially after all writes.

intentionalTradeoffs: connect-src is widened to the asset protocol so pdf.js can fetch local PDF bytes; script in the app origin can now fetch local files through it.
Untrusted PDF parsing moves from WebKit's isolated viewer into an app-origin worker (mitigated by disabled eval/scripting/XFA and canvas-only output).
Eager rendering of all pages: memory grows with pages times scale squared; lazy rendering deferred.
Concurrent wave plans gate typecheck only on their own files (sibling-noise rule); authoritative gates are in pdf-shortcuts-finalize steps 1-7.
supportedEdgeCases: Rapid zoom and reload races (render-task cancellation plus load-generation guard).
Worker initialization failure resets the singleton so a later load can retry.
CMap (non-embedded CJK) and JPX image PDFs via bundled cmaps, standard fonts and the OpenJPEG nowasm fallback.
Hidden panes ignore wheel zoom; zoom clamps at the bounds; plain wheel scrolls normally.
File-list focus: j/k move selection and Enter opens while a PDF is previewed.
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Text selection, links, forms, search and printing within PDFs.
Lazy/virtualized page rendering for very large PDFs.
residualRisks: Worker CSP on tauri://localhost and CMap/JPX fixture rendering are known only at pdf-shortcuts-finalize runtime check (step 8).
README wording 'under the pointer' slightly exceeds the design text (low).
vite.config.ts is not covered by bun run typecheck; the pdfjsResources plugin is proven by the foundation smoke check and finalize step 6 (low).
Sibling-noise rules depend on own-file grep; authoritative serial gates in finalize steps 1-7 catch anything masked (low).

acceptanceCriteria: previewZoomDirectionFromWheel and PreviewZoomDirection are exported from PreviewPane.tsx; the predicate returns null unless (altKey || ctrlKey) && deltaY !== 0, 'in' for deltaY < 0, 'out' for deltaY > 0, and never calls preventDefault.
PREVIEW_ZOOM_MIN, RENDERED_PREVIEW_ZOOM_MAX and IMAGE_PREVIEW_ZOOM_MAX are exported with unchanged values.
PreviewPane handleWheel zooms on Alt or Ctrl wheel, prevents default only when zooming, ignores plain wheel and hidden panes, and clamps.
Scoped vitest, own-file typecheck and biome checks exit 0; progress log updated.
pdfjs-dist is pinned to an exact version in package.json with a bun.lock integrity entry and no trustedDependencies.

src/features/preview/pdfjs.ts exports the pinned contract (?worker workerPort singleton with failure reset, cMapUrl/standardFontDataUrl/wasmUrl, useWasm:false, isEvalSupported:false, enableXfa:false) and its tests pass.
The Vite pdfjsResources plugin serves cmaps, standard_fonts and wasm resources in dev and copies them to dist/pdfjs on build.
src-tauri/tauri.conf.json CSP change is limited to connect-src; cargo check passes.
Scoped verification steps 1, 3, 4 and 6 exit 0; step 2 shows no errors in this plan's files; step 5 smoke results recorded; progress log updated.
verification: bunx biome check vite.config.ts src/features/preview/pdfjs.ts src/features/preview/pdfjs.vitest.ts package.json --diagnostic-level=warn

acceptanceCriteria: PdfFilePreviewPane.tsx contains no <iframe> or focusable elements and imports pdf.js only through ./pdfjs.
Pages render to canvases inside .pane__body at zoom*devicePixelRatio with 50-300% clamp via +/- and Alt/Ctrl wheel using the shared helper and constants.
Reload on refresh/revision/localResourceGeneration change is generation-guarded with render-task cancellation.
Stale PDF iframe CSS (preview-pdf-frame, preview--embedded-pdf) removed from src; new PDF canvas CSS present in App.css.
Scoped vitest, own-file typecheck, biome and stale-selector checks pass; progress log updated.
Video previews gain pane-local 50-300% zoom via +/- and Alt/Ctrl wheel using the shared helper; audio has no zoom handlers or header percentage.
Space play/pause, Ctrl+D/Ctrl+U seeks and autoplay behavior unchanged.
Scoped vitest, own-file typecheck and biome checks exit 0; progress log updated.
WorkspaceShell vitest tests prove L, Cmd+O, +/-, r, D, j/k (document scroll and file-list selection), Enter and q work with a PDF open.
README shortcut table documents Alt+wheel (and Ctrl+wheel/pinch) zoom.
Final verification steps 1-7 exit 0 with complete logs recorded; dist contains pdfjs cmaps, standard_fonts, wasm fallback and the pdf.worker asset.
Packaged debug runtime check (step 8) renders plain, CMap and JPX fixture PDFs with no CSP, fake-worker, CMap or OpenJPEG console errors, or records an explicit verification gap.
No production code changes; defects are reported to the owning plan.
